name: Clawser
description: Private full-browser viewing and human takeover links for OpenClaw

publicBaseUrl.description: HTTPS origin reverse-proxied to this plugin sidecar; no path suffix

comparisonProxyUrl.description: Optional fixed loopback HTTP origin for the authenticated disposable noVNC comparison service; disabled when absent

profiles.description: Explicit shareable profile name to loopback CDP HTTP origin

desktop.description: Production full-browser handoff through an operator-managed private Unix controller; ordinary Chromium CDP profile must match controller identity and set attachOnly=true with the openclaw driver. Legacy tab sharing is the default when disabled or absent.

socketPath.description: Required when enabled: absolute owner-only controller Unix socket path; never expose over the public viewer tunnel

profile.description: Required when enabled: dedicated ordinary OpenClaw browser profile shared with the controller; handoff includes all tabs

ownerGroupSessions.description: Operator opt-in: exact group/channel base session keys, no wildcards or thread entries. A verified native owner turn may deliver its one-use bearer link to the same requesting group/thread; any group member can claim it. Google Chat permits only a :thread:<24 lowercase hex> suffix. Native per-sender and conversation identity are required; absent provenance uses the SDK external-user default, and explicit automated provenance is denied; never use a shared-admin HTTP agent proxy.

cloudflare.description: Optional operator-managed Cloudflare Quick Tunnel for existing-browser CDP mode. Exposes the authenticated viewer only, never CDP. Mutually exclusive with Funnel. Desktop uses its separate controller transport.

binaryPath.description: Required when enabled: absolute path to an operator-installed trusted cloudflared executable

cliCommands.name: clawser
cliCommands.description: Set up and check the Clawser browser handoff runtime
